modal.title: Create a class
modal.description: You're creating a class template. Once saved, you'll be able to schedule it on your calendar.

basicInfo.title: Basic info
basicInfo.description: Provide information about the class for your clients
basicInfo.typeQuestion: What type of class template do you want to create?

workshop.label: Workshop
workshop.helper: A specialized class that happens in specific period of time

name.label: Name
name.placeholder: Give your class a name e.g. Vinyasa Yoga

category.label: Category
category.helper: These categories will display on your branded website and app for the different types of class

descriptionField.label: Description
descriptionField.placeholder: Add a description of the class for your clients

image.label: Cover image
image.description: This image will be shown to clients on your website and app when browsing classes.

altText.label: Image alt text
altText.placeholder: E.g. a close-up of a person meditating
altText.helper: Help visually impaired understand the cover image. Won't be shown visually.

color.label: Color
color.description: A color makes this class easier to spot across your calendar and schedule

bookingWindow.title: Booking window
bookingWindow.description: Set when clients can book this class

opening.title: Opening of booking window
opening.description: Future sessions can be booked if they start in less than

closing.title: Closing of booking window
closing.description: Select until when members can book before the start of the session.

cancellation.title: Cancellation policy
cancellation.description: Select until when members can cancel for free before the start of the session (late-cancellations)

warnings.nullFirstBookingUntil: Warning: the opening of the booking window is set to 0. Members will not be able to book this class.
warnings.lowFirstBookingUntil: Warning: the opening of the booking window is less than 24 hours before the session. Members may not have enough time to book.
warnings.highLastBooking: Warning: the closing of the booking window is more than 2 hours before the session starts. Members may book very far in advance.

customRestrictions.title: Booking rules by segment
customRestrictions.toggleLabel: Apply different booking and cancellation rules to specific member segments.
customRestrictions.maxHint: You can add up to {{max}} custom rules.
customRestrictions.maxReached: You already have added {{max}} custom rules.

automaticCancellation.title: Automatic Cancellation
automaticCancellation.alert: Owners, admins, teachers, and booked members are notified automatically.
